definitions.explanation: A common household insect pest known for its flat body, long antennae, and ability to survive in various conditions.

examples.japanese: {台所|だいどころ}でゴキブリを{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a cockroach in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ゴキブリが{苦手|にがて}だ。
ゴキブリ{退治|たいじ}のスプレーを{買|か}った。

notes:
ゴキブリ is one of the most feared household pests in Japan, especially during the hot and humid summer months.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゴキブリが{出|で}る: cockroaches appear (in the house)
- ゴキブリを{退治|たいじ}する: to exterminate cockroaches
- ゴキブリ{対策|たいさく}: cockroach countermeasures
- ゴキブリホイホイ: cockroach trap (brand name used generically)
- ゴキブリ{駆除|くじょ}: cockroach extermination

CULTURE:
Many Japanese people have a strong aversion to cockroaches. In casual speech and online, people often refer to them simply as "G" (ジー) to avoid saying the word directly.

SEASON:
Most commonly seen in {夏|なつ} (summer) when heat and humidity create ideal conditions. Prevention products sell strongly before summer begins.
